title: ReCiter AI Spotlight Artifact
description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for the spotlight.json artifact published by Phase 6 Spotlight Pipeline. Validates the 10-active-spotlight + 50-pool-snapshot shape with first/last author payloads keyed for SPS headshot resolution. Additive non-breaking rule per Phase 5 D-11: no additionalProperties:false at any level.

personIdentifier.description: WCM faculty UID and SPS photo-store join key. May be an empty string for a non-faculty external/trainee co-lead under the #231 B1 OR rule (the qualifying faculty lead always carries a real UID; both leads are never empty). Consumers resolve a headshot only when non-empty. minLength relaxed from 1 in #233 to admit pid-less co-leads.

label.description: LLM-canonical subtopic label (D-19 — used as identity).

display_name.description: UI-facing label (D-19 — UI-only; falls back to label if absent).

lede.description: Editorial lede; 22-38 words enforced upstream by critic regex bundle (length range here is byte bounds, not word bounds).

lede_grounded_pmids.description: PMIDs the lede grounded against (editorial subset of papers). Must be a subset of papers[].pmid.

durable_id.description: Durable subtopic id (#191 brick D3), stamped additively alongside subtopic_id when the propagate_durable_ids gate is on. Absent when the gate is off or the slug has no durable id yet (one-run lag).

spotlights.description: Active spotlights for the publish run. Up to SELECTION_TARGET (spotlight/rotation_selector.py); widened 10->25 with the 2026-06-10 ship-all decision (publish every cleared candidate; SPS random-samples 8 on the home page).

pool_snapshot.description: Pool ranking snapshot for transparency — up to POOL_SIZE (spotlight/pool_ranker.py) entries; widened 50->150 with #164's pool expansion.
